verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects or BNPL as merchant payment methods. Checkout Pro's "customizable payment methods" with a split into 2 parts names no digital wallets or local methods. The QR purchases and transfers items describe the consumer app, not something a founder offers through a checkout integration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration
